plan.line: a DS18B20 temperature sensor (the bare 3-leg part, 1-Wire): measures temperature from −55 to 125 °C, ±0.5 °C; its 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor is added automatically. Use it when the idea names a DS18B20 or a precise temperature; it measures the air or what it touches, but the bare part must stay dry. It doesn't measure humidity.

code.pinLine: DS18B20 temperature sensor {ref} on {gpio}: ow = onewire.OneWire(Pin({g})); ds = ds18x20.DS18X20(ow); roms = ds.scan() (a list with the sensor's address; empty = check the wiring). Each reading: ds.convert_temp(), then time.sleep_ms(750), then ds.read_temp(roms[0]) gives degrees C with decimals. Don't read faster than every 750 ms.
